title: MobileBench-OL: A Comprehensive Chinese Benchmark for Evaluating Mobile GUI Agents in Real-World Environment
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026
authors_zh: Qinzhuo Wu, Zhizhuo Yang, Hanhao Li, Pengzhi Gao, Wei Liu, Jian Luan
paper_type_zh: 真实设备移动GUI智能体基准与自动评测环境
best_for_zh: 研究移动GUI智能体、环境交互轨迹、环境型verifier、噪声鲁棒性、状态重置与评测污染的读者
one_line: MobileBench-OL publishes 1,080 real-device Chinese-app evaluation cases with XPath-like success rules, noise injection and inverse-task resets, but not the paper's complete sampled trajectories or a frozen APK/device environment.
MobileBench-OL公开覆盖80款中文应用的1,080个真实设备评测项，以XPath式成功规则、噪声注入和逆任务重置评分，但没有发布论文所用的完整成败轨迹或冻结APK/设备环境。
why: It shows how screenshots, XML state, actions, terminal signaling, partial predicates and reset episodes form an auditable mobile-agent feedback contract, while demonstrating why public rules, app drift, imperfect resets and missing failed-rollout lineage constrain reuse to evaluation rather than training.
inclusion_reason: MobileBench-OL makes real-device mobile-agent evaluation a concrete environment-and-verifier object: public Chinese-app task records drive screenshot/XML/action episodes, XPath-like success predicates, partial-condition metrics, noise injection and inverse-task resets, while its mutable apps, public rules and incomplete trajectory/APK release expose the key audit boundary.

title: Problem
问题
html:
MobileBench-OL is a real-device mobile-GUI evaluation benchmark published in Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026. The official paper, DOI, arXiv record, and Xiaomi Research repository are verified. Its question is narrower than generic phone automation: can an agent execute Chinese-app tasks under long horizons, unfamiliar interfaces, exploration requirements, and stochastic real-world disturbances while an automatic evaluator and reset process keep trials comparable?

The benchmark reports 1,080 evaluation cases across 80 apps and five subsets: Base 310, Long-Tail 340, Long-Horizon 60, GUI-Reasoning 60, and Noise-Robust 310. Noise-Robust reuses Base tasks as seeds, so these counts represent 770 distinct task specifications plus 310 Base-derived noisy cases, not 1,080 independent prompts. Long-Horizon tasks require at least 20 golden steps; GUI-Reasoning difficulty is based on icon discovery, hidden functions, and hierarchical navigation rather than step count (Paper §3.2, Table 4).

One released task record contains a task identifier, natural-language goal, app home-page information, human golden-step count, key nodes or rule material, and optional reset fields. When executed, it becomes a full episode over screenshots, XML UI state, normalized actions, responses, termination reason, rule matches, and success. The primary object is therefore an evaluation task/environment/verifier specification. It is not a frozen corpus of the paper's agent trajectories.

This belongs in environment_agent_trajectory_data because the result depends on a live device state, app/network behavior, an action-observation loop, environmental predicates, and state reset. It does not establish a training recipe, safe real-device deployment, or cross-app reasoning: training_use is evaluation only, and the authors explicitly list complex cross-app tasks as absent.

The Card reaches L4 collection depth by tying task counts, episode fields, feedback rules, reported scores, release contents, licenses, and replay risks to primary sources. Its central boundary is that the code and task/rule CSVs are public, while the complete successful/failed validation and experiment trajectories, promised APK bundle, account fixtures, and immutable device snapshot were not verified in the official release.

MobileBench-OL是发表于Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026的真实设备移动GUI评测基准。官方论文、DOI、arXiv条目和Xiaomi Research仓库均已核实。它处理的问题比泛化“手机自动化”更具体：当任务包含长时执行、陌生界面、自主探索及随机真实环境干扰时，智能体能否完成中文应用操作，同时由自动评测器和重置流程保持不同试验可比较？

论文报告80款应用上的1,080个评测项，分为Base 310、Long-Tail 340、Long-Horizon 60、GUI-Reasoning 60及Noise-Robust 310。Noise-Robust以Base任务为seed，因此这些数字表示770个独立任务规格外加310个由Base派生的噪声评测项，而不是1,080个互不重复的prompt。Long-Horizon任务至少需要20个golden step；GUI-Reasoning难度则由图标发现、隐藏功能和层级导航衡量，而非按步数划分（论文第3.2节、表4）。

一条已发布任务记录包含task identifier、自然语言goal、应用主页信息、人工golden-step数、key node或规则材料，以及可选reset字段。执行后，它形成由截图、XML界面状态、规范化动作、response、终止原因、规则匹配和成功标签组成的完整episode。因此，主要数据对象是评测任务/环境/verifier规格，不是论文智能体轨迹的冻结语料。

本工作属于environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为结果取决于实时设备状态、应用/网络行为、action-observation loop、环境谓词及状态重置。它没有建立训练recipe、真实设备安全部署结论或跨应用推理能力；training_use仅为evaluation，作者也明确把复杂cross-app任务列为缺失项。

本Card通过primary source把任务规模、episode字段、反馈规则、报告分数、发布内容、许可证和回放风险连接起来，达到L4采集深度。最关键边界是：代码与任务/规则CSV已经公开，但完整成功/失败验证轨迹和实验轨迹、论文承诺的APK包、账户fixture及不可变设备snapshot均未在官方发布中核实。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is an online Chinese mobile-agent benchmark that combines five capability slices with a rule-based full-episode evaluator and inverse-task reset on physical phones. Instead of comparing an action to one reference path, MobileBench-OL checks whether the trajectory reaches task-specific GUI/action conditions, allowing different navigation paths to satisfy the same goal.

The evaluation object joins four layers. A task specification provides the goal, app start page, golden-step budget, and success-rule material. The environment returns real screenshots and XML hierarchies. The evaluated agent emits normalized click, type, scroll, navigation, wait, long-press, and finished actions. The evaluator then produces complete success, sub-condition progress, step ratio, and one of early termination, overdue termination, or failure.

Its feedback contract is environmental and episode-level. XPath-like rules inspect element attributes such as text, resource-id, package, selected state, and the relation between an action coordinate and an element or parent bounding box. Full success requires every condition and an explicit Complete/finished action. The verifier can observe recorded screens, XML nodes, actions, and termination; it cannot prove unobserved server-side semantics, privacy safety, user intent beyond the encoded rule, or correctness of state omitted from the rule.

Relative to AndroidWorld, LlamaTouch, Mobile-Env, and SPA-Bench, the paper's claimed direction is broader coverage of mainstream Chinese apps on physical devices, explicit long-horizon and exploration subsets, random injection of repeat/unexecuted/delay/pop-up noise, and agent-executed inverse resets. The components are not individually new: GUI actions, dynamic environments, XPath-style checks, noise tests, and reset tasks all have precedents. The contribution is their integration into this evaluation surface and its evidence about current-agent failure.

The feedback is also a public attack surface. Goals and key-node/rule material are released without a hidden test split. A model tuned on these records could memorize tasks or optimize observable XPath conditions while missing unencoded semantics. MobileBench-OL should therefore be read as an inspectable evaluation and verifier recipe, not as hidden reward data or an automatically safe source for agent training.

本文贡献是一套在线中文移动智能体基准：在物理手机上，把五类能力切片、基于规则的full-episode evaluator和逆任务重置结合起来。MobileBench-OL不要求动作匹配唯一参考路径，而是检查轨迹是否达到任务特定GUI/动作条件，因此不同导航路径可以满足同一目标。

评测对象连接四层。任务规格提供goal、应用起始页面、golden-step预算和成功规则材料；环境返回真实截图与XML hierarchy；被测智能体输出规范化click、type、scroll、导航、wait、long-press与finished动作；评测器随后给出完整成功、sub-condition进度、step ratio，以及early termination、overdue termination或failure之一。

其反馈契约是environmental且作用于episode级。XPath式规则检查text、resource-id、package、selected状态等元素属性，以及动作坐标是否落入元素或父节点bounding box。完整成功必须同时满足全部条件并显式输出Complete/finished。verifier能观察已记录屏幕、XML node、动作与终止信息；它不能证明未观察到的服务器端语义、隐私安全、编码规则之外的用户意图，或规则遗漏状态的正确性。

相较AndroidWorld、LlamaTouch、Mobile-Env与SPA-Bench，论文主张的方向变化是：在物理设备上覆盖更主流的中文应用，单设long-horizon与exploration子集，随机注入repeat/unexecuted/delay/pop-up噪声，并由智能体执行逆任务重置。这些组件本身并非全新：GUI动作、动态环境、XPath式检查、噪声测试和reset task均有先例；贡献在于把它们整合成同一评测面，并展示当前智能体的具体失败。

该反馈同时也是公开攻击面。goal与key-node/规则材料已经发布，却没有hidden test split。用这些记录调优的模型可能记忆任务，或只优化可观察XPath条件而遗漏未编码语义。因此，MobileBench-OL应被理解为可检查的评测与verifier recipe，而不是隐藏reward数据或可直接安全用于agent training的来源。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs. The benchmark starts from 80 versioned Chinese apps in 12 categories and manually authored tasks. Table 4 contains 310 Base, 340 Long-Tail, 60 Long-Horizon, 60 GUI-Reasoning, and 310 Noise-Robust cases. The last subset reuses Base tasks. Each test begins at the relevant app home page; paper devices have installed apps and logged-in accounts.

Construction. Annotators create tasks from scratch and execute them on real devices to obtain golden trajectories and step counts. Domain experts derive success conditions from task-trajectory pairs. UI-TARS-1.5 and annotators sample diverse completion paths; Auto-Eval labels them; experts inspect discrepancies and revise rules. The paper reports at least five samples per task, but not the exact human/model mix, total attempts, rejected attempts, or record-level rule-revision history (Paper §3.3, Figure 3).

Interaction. A device supplies a screenshot and XML UI hierarchy; the agent also receives its interaction history according to its scaffold. Model-specific actions are translated into a unified space: click, type, scroll, press home/back, wait, long press, and finished. The maximum episode length is three times the human golden steps, a three-second delay follows every action, and the loop stops on completion signaling or the step limit (Appendix A.3-A.4, G.2).

Noise and reset. Noise-Robust injects one of repeat, unexecuted, delay, or pop-up with 20% probability at each step. After a benchmark round, a reliable agent executes 255 fine-grained inverse tasks. Resets are task-level, app-level, unnecessary, or infeasible; infeasible cases widen the success condition instead of fully restoring state. Exact noise seeds, account/server fixtures, reset retry policy, and a state-diff ledger are not disclosed.

Verification and outputs. Success conditions are normalized XPath-like conjunctions over GUI elements and critical actions. All conditions plus Complete yields Success; all conditions at the step limit yields Overdue; Complete before all conditions yields Early Termination; otherwise the label is Failure. The released harness writes task/success pairs and per-task trajectory.json objects with action, image, response, summary, and success; Sub-SR and Step Ratio add partial and efficiency metrics.

Release and use. The official repository provides Python code, configs, evaluator modules, and seven task/reset CSVs. Dataset terms are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and source code is Apache-2.0. Reproduction needs a physical Android device with ADB/uiautomator2 plus appropriate apps/accounts. The paper promises all 80 APKs, but no official APK bundle was verified. There is no train/dev/test split, frozen paper-trajectory release, semantic version, or complete device/account/server snapshot, so the supported use is evaluation, not SFT or RL training.

输入。 基准从12类80款带版本的中文应用与人工编写任务开始。表4包含Base 310、Long-Tail 340、Long-Horizon 60、GUI-Reasoning 60及Noise-Robust 310个评测项，最后一类复用Base任务。每次测试从对应应用主页开始；论文设备已安装应用并完成账户登录。

构造。 annotator从零编写任务并在真实设备执行，得到golden trajectory和步数。领域专家根据task-trajectory pair编写成功条件；UI-TARS-1.5与annotator采样多种完成路径；Auto-Eval打标签；专家检查分歧并修改规则。论文报告每项任务至少有五个样本，但没有披露准确的人类/模型比例、总尝试数、被拒绝尝试或逐记录规则修订历史（论文第3.3节、图3）。

交互。 设备提供截图和XML UI hierarchy；智能体还会按其scaffold接收交互历史。不同模型动作被转换为统一空间：click、type、scroll、press home/back、wait、long press和finished。episode最大长度为人工golden step的三倍，每个动作后等待三秒，循环在完成信号或步数上限时停止（附录A.3-A.4、G.2）。

噪声与重置。 Noise-Robust在每一步以20%概率注入repeat、unexecuted、delay或pop-up之一。每轮基准结束后，一个可靠智能体执行255项细粒度逆任务。reset分为task-level、app-level、无需reset或infeasible；infeasible情形通过放宽成功条件处理，而非完全恢复状态。准确噪声seed、账户/服务器fixture、reset retry政策与state-diff ledger均未披露。

验证与输出。 成功条件是针对GUI元素和关键动作的规范化XPath式合取规则。全部条件加Complete判为Success；满足条件但到达步数上限判为Overdue；条件未全部满足却输出Complete判为Early Termination；其他情形判为Failure。已发布harness写出task/success pair，以及含action、image、response、summary和success的逐任务trajectory.json；Sub-SR与Step Ratio分别补充部分进度和效率指标。

发布与用途。 官方仓库提供Python代码、config、evaluator模块及七个任务/reset CSV。数据采用CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，源码采用Apache-2.0。复现需要支持ADB/uiautomator2的物理Android设备及相应应用/账户。论文承诺提供80个APK，但未核实到官方APK bundle。由于没有train/dev/test split、冻结论文轨迹发布、semantic version或完整设备/账户/服务器snapshot，受证据支持的用途是evaluation，而非SFT或RL训练。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
All performance figures below are author-reported and have not been independently replayed. Under a three-times-golden-step budget with three seconds after each action, UI-TARS-1.5-7B is the strongest Table 5 baseline: 60.97% Base SR, 41.76% Long-Tail, 15.00% Long-Horizon, 38.33% GUI-Reasoning, and 56.77% Noise-Robust. Its corresponding Sub-SR values are 64.84%, 46.32%, 45.25%, 40.83%, and 62.18%. The 15.00% Long-Horizon result is the clearest evidence for the paper's claim that full multi-subtask completion remains difficult; it is not evidence that each failure arose from reasoning rather than grounding, verifier, state, or budget effects (Table 5).

The verifier is empirically calibrated against humans on 1,080 UI-TARS-1.5 episodes. Table 12 reports 534 true positives, 5 false positives, 22 false negatives, and 519 true negatives: 97.50% overall agreement, with Auto-Eval SR 49.91% versus human SR 51.48%. The 27 disagreements matter more than the aggregate accuracy for reuse: false positives become verifier-gaming opportunities, while false negatives discard valid behavior. Long-Horizon happened to show 100% agreement on only 60 examples and should not be generalized beyond that sample.

Reset validation executes 255 task-level/app-level reset tasks across Base, Long-Tail, GUI-Reasoning, and Noise-Robust. Human success rates in Table 13 are 96.92%, 94.35%, 95.65%, and 92.31%; Auto-Eval estimates are close but not identical. These results support the narrower claim that inverse tasks usually restore observable state. They do not show bitwise state restoration, cover Long-Horizon resets, or eliminate account/server drift and infeasible actions.

Budget changes performance. On Base, UI-TARS-1.5 pass@1/3/5 is 60.97%, 69.03%, and 73.87%; Qwen2.5-VL is 17.10%, 31.29%, and 39.35% (Appendix H.3, Table 20). Scores must therefore report retry count, and comparisons cannot silently mix single-run SR with best-of-k success.

The release itself is verifiable but incomplete. The official data tree exposes 310 Base, 340 Long-Tail, 60 Long-Horizon, and 60 GUI-Reasoning task rows plus reset files; README documents local trajectory output. GitHub flags illegal quoting in longtail.csv at line 118. No frozen baseline-result bundle or the ≥5-per-task validation trajectories are present. The paper also observes no more than 5% score fluctuation after updating apps two months later, which demonstrates version sensitivity rather than eliminating it (Appendix A.2).

以下性能数字均为作者报告，尚未被独立replay。在三倍golden-step预算且每个动作后等待三秒的条件下，UI-TARS-1.5-7B是表5最强baseline：Base SR 60.97%、Long-Tail 41.76%、Long-Horizon 15.00%、GUI-Reasoning 38.33%、Noise-Robust 56.77%；对应Sub-SR依次为64.84%、46.32%、45.25%、40.83%和62.18%。15.00%的Long-Horizon结果最直接支持“完整多子任务执行仍很困难”，但不能证明每次失败都源于reasoning，而非grounding、verifier、状态或预算因素（表5）。

verifier在1,080条UI-TARS-1.5 episode上与人类标签进行校准。表12报告534个true positive、5个false positive、22个false negative和519个true negative：总体一致率97.50%，Auto-Eval SR为49.91%，人类SR为51.48%。对于复用，27处分歧比总体accuracy更重要：false positive会成为verifier-gaming机会，false negative则会丢弃有效行为。Long-Horizon在仅60条样本上恰好达到100%一致，不能向更广场景外推。

reset验证在Base、Long-Tail、GUI-Reasoning和Noise-Robust上执行255项task-level/app-level reset task。表13中人类判定成功率分别为96.92%、94.35%、95.65%和92.31%，Auto-Eval估计接近但并不相同。这些结果只支持“逆任务通常能恢复可观察状态”，不能证明bitwise状态恢复，也没有覆盖Long-Horizon reset，更未消除账户/服务器漂移和不可逆动作。

预算会改变表现。在Base上，UI-TARS-1.5的pass@1/3/5为60.97%、69.03%和73.87%；Qwen2.5-VL为17.10%、31.29%和39.35%（附录H.3、表20）。因此分数必须同时报告retry次数，比较时不能把single-run SR与best-of-k成功率混在一起。

发布物可核实但不完整。官方data tree包含310条Base、340条Long-Tail、60条Long-Horizon和60条GUI-Reasoning任务记录及reset文件；README说明了本地轨迹输出。GitHub还提示longtail.csv第118行存在非法引号。仓库没有冻结baseline结果bundle，也没有每任务至少五条的验证轨迹。论文在两个月后更新应用时观察到的分数波动不超过5%，这证明了版本敏感性，而非消除了版本漂移（附录A.2）。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Dynamic mobile benchmarks such as AndroidWorld, LlamaTouch, and Mobile-Env already use online interaction and state-based evaluation; SPA-Bench already broadens app coverage, and GUI-Robust/D-GARA already study anomalies. MobileBench-OL's concrete change is to assemble these concerns around physical phones, 80 Chinese apps, logged-in real-network operation, and five distinct capability slices rather than presenting another static screenshot/action corpus.

The task design separates three often-conflated factors. Base and Long-Tail test common versus less familiar app interfaces; Long-Horizon fixes hard tasks by at least 20 golden steps; GUI-Reasoning scores exploration requirements such as icon understanding, hidden-function discovery, and hierarchical navigation; Noise-Robust perturbs execution with four random disturbance types. This decomposition is a useful direction signal, but the subsets overlap in apps and tasks, so their counts are not independent evidence of coverage.

The second change is a full feedback-and-reset pipeline. Experts derive path-tolerant XPath-like rules from successful traces, validate them on mixed human/UI-TARS-1.5 trajectories, and couple them to explicit termination semantics. A separate inverse-task agent attempts to restore mutable app state between rounds. This makes verifier false positives, false negatives, reset failures, and version drift visible parts of the benchmark contract rather than hidden implementation details.

What is not new includes normalized GUI actions, screenshot/XML observations, rule-based predicates, agent rollouts, app-specific reset scripts, and retry-based pass@k. The 80-app/1,080-case scale and the integration of these mechanisms are engineering contributions; they do not by themselves prove record quality, safe automation, or a reusable training dataset.

For reasoning-data research, the main novelty is the inspectable chain from task and real-device state through action trajectory, condition-level feedback, terminal signaling, injected noise, and inverse reset. Before reuse, researchers still need a hidden/refreshable evaluation split, pinned device/APK/account/server manifest, full successful and failed trajectory release, rule-revision ledger, exact noise seeds, and rights review for third-party apps. Without them, the artifact is a strong evaluation recipe but a weak training-data release.

AndroidWorld、LlamaTouch与Mobile-Env等动态移动基准已经采用在线交互和状态评测；SPA-Bench已经扩大应用覆盖；GUI-Robust/D-GARA也已研究异常。MobileBench-OL的具体变化，是围绕物理手机、80款中文应用、真实网络与登录态操作及五种能力切片整合这些问题，而不是再发布一个静态截图/动作语料。

任务设计拆分了三类常被混淆的因素。Base与Long-Tail测试常见和较陌生应用界面；Long-Horizon用至少20个golden step界定困难任务；GUI-Reasoning按图标理解、隐藏功能发现和层级导航等探索要求打分；Noise-Robust用四类随机干扰改变执行过程。这种拆分具有方向价值，但不同子集共享应用和任务，因此子集计数不能被当成相互独立的覆盖证据。

第二项变化是完整反馈与reset pipeline。专家从成功轨迹推导容忍多路径的XPath式规则，在人类/UI-TARS-1.5混合轨迹上验证，并把规则与显式终止语义结合；另一个逆任务智能体尝试在轮次间恢复可变应用状态。这使verifier false positive、false negative、reset failure和版本漂移成为基准契约的可见部分，而非隐藏实现细节。

并非新组件的部分包括规范化GUI action、截图/XML observation、规则谓词、agent rollout、应用特定reset script及基于retry的pass@k。80个应用/1,080个评测项的规模与机制整合属于工程贡献，不能单独证明逐记录质量、安全自动化能力或可复用训练数据集。

对推理数据研究而言，主要新意是把task与真实设备状态、action trajectory、条件级反馈、终止信号、噪声注入及逆向reset连接成可检查链路。复用前仍需hidden/可刷新评测split、固定设备/APK/账户/服务器manifest、完整成败轨迹发布、规则修订ledger、准确噪声seed，以及第三方应用权利审查。缺少这些材料时，该artifact是较强的评测recipe，但不是充分的训练数据发布。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Public evaluation surface: No train/dev/test or hidden partition is defined. Goals, golden-step counts, key nodes, and rule material are public, enabling memorization, task-specific tuning, and XPath verifier gaming. The from-scratch authoring claim reduces direct copied-task risk but is not a training-corpus overlap audit.
  • Verifier error: Table 12 contains 5 false positives and 22 false negatives. XPath predicates observe selected GUI elements/actions, not complete task semantics, off-screen server state, privacy, or harmful intermediate side effects. Explicit Complete signaling can also separate actual task completion from the reported label.
  • Reset and state leakage: Human reset success is above 90%, not perfect. Task/app inverse operations cannot guarantee an identical device, account, cache, recommendation, inventory, message, or server state. Infeasible tasks are handled by broadened success conditions, which can change what the benchmark rewards.
  • Environment drift and replay: The paper uses three physical phones, versioned apps, verified accounts, and a remote platform, but exact phone/OS images, credentials policy, account fixtures, server state, dependency lock, and public platform snapshot are unknown. The paper promises 80 APKs; no verified official APK bundle is present in the inspected repository.
  • Trajectory-release boundary: At least five paths per task informed rule validation, and baseline episodes produced all reported results, yet the complete successful, failed, reset-failed, timed-out, retried, and discarded trajectory corpus is absent. README documents locally generated trajectories, not an immutable paper-result release.
  • Noise and budget confounds: Disturbances occur with 20% step probability, but seeds and event manifests are unknown. Retry count changes pass rate substantially, and a three-times-golden-step cap plus fixed waits can turn scaffold efficiency into an apparent reasoning difference.
  • Data/release quality: The repository has no semantic release or checksum manifest, and GitHub reports illegal quoting in longtail.csv at line 118. Parser behavior, mutable main, and app updates can change tasks or labels; the paper itself observes up to 5% score fluctuation after version updates.
  • Rights, privacy, and scope: Dataset terms are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and code is Apache-2.0, but third-party APK/content/account rights are not resolved by those licenses. Authors state privacy-exposing data were removed, while the filter specification and account-safety audit remain unreleased. The benchmark lacks cross-app tasks and cannot establish deployment safety.

• 公开评测面： 没有train/dev/test或hidden partition。goal、golden-step数、key node与规则材料均公开，可被用于记忆、任务特定调优和XPath verifier gaming。从零编写任务只能降低直接复制任务的风险，不等同于训练语料重叠审计。
  • Verifier误差： 表12包含5个false positive和22个false negative。XPath谓词观察选定GUI元素/动作，而不是完整任务语义、屏外服务器状态、隐私或有害中间副作用。显式Complete信号还会使实际任务完成与最终标签发生分离。
  • 重置与状态泄漏： 人类判定reset成功率高于90%，但并非完美。task/app逆操作无法保证设备、账户、cache、推荐、库存、消息或服务器状态完全一致。infeasible任务通过放宽成功条件处理，这会改变基准实际奖励的行为。
  • 环境漂移与回放： 论文使用三台物理手机、带版本应用、已验证账户和远程平台，但准确phone/OS镜像、credentials政策、账户fixture、服务器状态、dependency lock及公开平台snapshot均为unknown。论文承诺80个APK，但检查的官方仓库没有可核实APK bundle。
  • 轨迹发布边界： 每项任务至少五条路径参与规则验证，baseline episode产生所有报告结果，但完整成功、失败、reset失败、超时、retry及discarded trajectory语料没有发布。README描述的是本地生成轨迹，不是不可变的论文结果发布。
  • 噪声与预算混杂： 干扰以每步20%概率发生，但seed和event manifest未知。retry次数会显著改变pass rate；三倍golden-step上限和固定等待时间还可能把scaffold效率差异表现成reasoning差异。
  • 数据/发布质量： 仓库没有semantic release或checksum manifest，GitHub还报告longtail.csv第118行存在非法引号。parser行为、可变main与应用更新都可能改变task或label；论文自身观察到版本更新后分数最多波动5%。
  • 权利、隐私与范围： 数据采用CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，代码采用Apache-2.0，但第三方APK/内容/账户权利并不会被这两种许可证自动解决。作者称已移除可能暴露隐私的数据，但filter规格和账户安全审计未发布。基准缺少cross-app任务，也不能证明部署安全性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the environment_agent_trajectory_data track, MobileBench-OL is useful first as an evaluation-environment recipe. A defensible derived episode should bind task ID and subset, exact task/rule CSV hash, app/APK version, device/OS/account fixture, initial screen/XML, model and scaffold settings, noise seed/events, every screenshot/XML/action/response, execution errors, matched subconditions, termination reason, final success, reset episode, and post-reset state. Without these fields, apparent model differences can be environment or replay differences.

The rule construction process is a practical verifier-design baseline. Researchers can build task-level predicates from multiple valid trajectories, require both state/action evidence and explicit stopping, compare full success with Sub-SR, and calibrate rule output against human labels. The released false-positive and false-negative counts provide a starting point for stress tests involving alternate paths, stale resource IDs, visually similar pages, server-side state, premature Complete, and harmful intermediate actions.

The five subsets support controlled failure analysis if shared tasks/apps are accounted for. Base versus Long-Tail probes interface familiarity; Long-Horizon can stratify omission, planning, grounding, and loop failures; GUI-Reasoning can test discovery depth; Base versus Noise-Robust can test recovery. Retry studies must hold task, rule, app/device state, model snapshot, action budget, and noise events fixed instead of comparing unpaired pass@k values.

The reset mechanism is useful as an audit checklist rather than proof of deterministic replay. Each task should declare whether reset is task-level, app-level, unnecessary, or infeasible; report reset success separately; retain failed reset episodes; compare relevant state before and after reset; and quarantine tasks whose server-side state cannot be restored. Widening the success predicate should be documented as a verifier change, not silently treated as state recovery.

The current reuse class is evaluation and audit only. Direct SFT, RL, preference, or reward-model reuse is not supported because the paper trajectory corpus, failure/rejection ledger, immutable environment bundle, hidden evaluation partition, decontamination policy, and complete APK/content rights are absent. Public task and rule CSVs should be treated as contaminated for any model trained on them and reserved from future clean evaluation.

对environment_agent_trajectory_data轨道而言，MobileBench-OL首先可作为评测环境recipe。可靠的派生episode应绑定task ID与subset、准确task/rule CSV hash、应用/APK版本、device/OS/account fixture、初始screen/XML、模型与scaffold设置、噪声seed/event、每一步截图/XML/action/response、执行错误、匹配subcondition、终止原因、最终成功、reset episode及reset后状态。缺少这些字段时，表面模型差异可能实际来自环境或replay差异。

规则构造流程可作为verifier设计baseline。研究者可以从多条有效轨迹构建task-level predicate，同时要求状态/动作证据与显式停止，比较完整成功和Sub-SR，并用人类标签校准规则输出。已发布的false positive与false negative计数可作为压力测试起点，覆盖替代路径、过期resource-id、视觉相似页面、服务器端状态、过早Complete及有害中间动作。

若正确处理共享task/app，五个子集可用于受控失败分析。Base与Long-Tail可测试界面熟悉度；Long-Horizon可分层分析遗漏、planning、grounding和loop failure；GUI-Reasoning可测试探索深度；Base与Noise-Robust可比较恢复能力。retry研究必须固定task、rule、应用/设备状态、模型snapshot、action budget和噪声event，不能直接比较不成对的pass@k。

reset机制更适合作为audit checklist，而非确定性回放证明。每项任务应声明reset属于task-level、app-level、无需reset或infeasible；单独报告reset成功；保留失败reset episode；比较reset前后相关状态；隔离无法恢复服务器状态的任务。放宽成功谓词应被记录为verifier变更，不能静默等同于状态恢复。

当前复用等级为仅限评测与审计。由于缺少论文轨迹语料、失败/拒绝ledger、不可变环境bundle、隐藏评测partition、decontamination政策及完整APK/内容权利，证据不支持直接用于SFT、RL、偏好学习或reward-model训练。任何使用公开task/rule CSV训练的模型都应被视为对该基准已污染，并退出后续clean evaluation。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read §3.2-3.3, §4, Appendix A, Appendix C-D, and Appendix G first to reconstruct task composition, screenshot/XML observations, normalized actions, XPath rules, termination labels, reset classes, and evaluation budget.
  • Keep the count boundary explicit: 1,080 evaluation cases = 770 distinct task specifications plus 310 Noise-Robust cases derived from Base tasks; it is not 1,080 independent prompts.
  • Interpret feedback as environmental, full_episode, and scalar_reward: full success requires all rule conditions and Complete, while Sub-SR is partial predicate coverage rather than step-level supervision.
  • Read Tables 12-13 before trusting automation: Auto-Eval has 5 false positives and 22 false negatives, and inverse resets exceed 90% human success but do not perfectly restore state.
  • Separate executable release from trajectory/environment release: task CSVs, evaluator code, and local trajectory writing are public; the paper's complete trajectories, APK bundle, device/account/server snapshot, and rejected attempts are not verified.
  • Before comparison or reuse, pin app/device versions, task/rule hashes, retry budget, noise events, model/API snapshot, reset outcome, parser behavior for the malformed Long-Tail CSV, and contamination status.

• 优先阅读第3.2-3.3节、第4节、附录A、附录C-D及附录G，以重建任务组成、截图/XML observation、规范化action、XPath规则、终止标签、reset类别与评测预算。
  • 始终明确计数边界：1,080个评测项=770个独立任务规格+310个由Base任务派生的Noise-Robust评测项，而不是1,080个互不重复prompt。
  • 把反馈解释为environmental、full_episode和scalar_reward：完整成功需要全部规则条件加Complete；Sub-SR是部分谓词覆盖，而不是step-level supervision。
  • 在信任自动化前先读表12-13：Auto-Eval存在5个false positive和22个false negative；逆任务reset的人类成功率超过90%，但不能完美恢复状态。
  • 区分可执行发布与轨迹/环境发布：任务CSV、evaluator代码和本地轨迹写出已公开；论文完整轨迹、APK bundle、设备/账户/服务器snapshot及被拒绝尝试均未核实。
  • 比较或复用前，应固定应用/设备版本、task/rule hash、retry预算、噪声event、模型/API snapshot、reset结果及异常Long-Tail CSV的parser行为，并标记contamination状态。
